monument:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original monument artwork for the Warhammer Fantasy Universalis EU4 mod, "The Warpmoon Project".
Primary request: a painterly dark-fantasy illustration of the colossal Skaven Morskittar Engine being constructed in Skavenblight to shoot down the Chaos Moon Morrslieb.
Scene: a cavernous subterranean foundry opening to a narrow night-sky shaft, crowded with crooked scaffolding, bronze pipes, iron braces, gears and eerie luminous green warpstone capacitors. Centerpiece is a massive rat-built cannon with an open spiked circular muzzle, cylindrical barrel tilted upwards, heavy piston carriage, mismatched riveted iron and tarnished brass. A few small hunched ratmen warlock-engineers in ragged red-brown robes tend it, unmistakable rat snouts and long tails, tiny relative to the machine. A small green moon is glimpsed through the distant shaft, intact. The weapon has NOT yet fired.
Composition: landscape exactly 2:1, ideally 1800x900. The machine's clear monumental silhouette dominates the center, full cannon and base visible, generous breathing room. Compose to read clearly when reduced to 300x150 pixels; large coherent shapes, minimal tiny detail.
Style: hand-painted gritty fantasy strategy game loading-screen art, textured oil and gouache brushwork, atmospheric depth, rich shadows but readable bright stone and metallic edges, sinister ingenuity, no photorealism or shiny 3D.
Palette: soot charcoal, aged brass, warm rust and muted brown with vivid sickly emerald warpstone light; restrained amber furnace light.
Constraints: single continuous painting; no borders, no lettering, no logos, no watermarks, no panels. Medieval-fantasy Skaven engineering, not modern sci-fi, not a spaceship, no humans as main characters.
event:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: original panoramic event illustration for a Warhammer Fantasy Universalis EU4 event chain about the Skaven Warpmoon Project.
Primary request: show a monumental Skaven cannon firing into the green Chaos Moon Morrslieb over Skavenblight, the impossible moment before the sky is torn apart.
Scene: a rat-built siege superweapon of riveted dark iron, tarnished brass, jagged focusing rings and glowing green warpstone reservoirs dominates the left foreground. Its muzzle points across the sky and projects a thin brilliant coherent emerald beam diagonally upward to a looming green moon on the right. The beam impacts the moon, which has several luminous fractures and only a few small fragments separating; the recognizable round moon remains dominant. Below lie crooked towers, smoke and scaffolding of Skavenblight, with tiny ratmen engineers silhouetted on a gantry for scale. Epic ominous dark fantasy, green light sweeping through dirty clouds. Clear visual cause-and-effect from cannon to beam to moon.
Composition: extremely wide cinematic panorama, ideally exactly 2048x528 pixels (128:33, matching a 512x132 event banner). If the output canvas cannot be that wide, put ALL essential subjects within the central horizontal band occupying the middle 34% of image height, with sky above and dim foreground below suitable for cropping. Cannon muzzle, beam, moon and skyline must all fit within that narrow center band. Leave room at both horizontal edges. Avoid tall vertical compositions.
Style: textured hand-painted oil/gouache fantasy strategy-game illustration, coherent silhouettes readable at 512x132, atmospheric painterly depth, striking lighting, not glossy CGI or photoreal.
Palette: charcoal clouds, muted bronze and russet machinery, cold moonlight, vivid emerald and acid-green beam. Match a gritty Skaven foundry monument painting.
Constraints: one seamless landscape scene, no border or frame, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no split panels, no modern military hardware, no spacecraft, no oversized foreground faces.
